1.w: For the music director, a song, a psalm. Shout out praise to God, all the earth!

2.w: Sing praises about the majesty of his reputation. Give him the honor he deserves!

3.w: Say to God: “How awesome are your deeds! Because of your great power your enemies cower in fear before you.

4.w: All the earth worships you and sings praises to you. They sing praises to your name.” (Selah)

5.w: Come and witness God’s exploits! His acts on behalf of people are awesome.

6.w: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the river on foot. Let us rejoice in him there.

7.w: He rules by his power forever; he watches the nations. Stubborn rebels should not exalt themselves. (Selah)

8.w: Praise our God, you nations. Loudly proclaim his praise.

9.w: He preserves our lives and does not allow our feet to slip.

10.w: For you, O God, tested us; you purified us like refined silver.

11.w: You led us into a trap; you caused us to suffer.

12.w: You allowed men to ride over our heads; we passed through fire and water, but you brought us out into a wide open place.

13.w: I will enter your temple with burnt sacrifices; I will fulfill the vows I made to you,

14.w: which my lips uttered and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

15.w: I will offer up to you fattened animals as burnt sacrifices, along with the smell of sacrificial rams. I will offer cattle and goats. (Selah)

16.w: Come! Listen, all you who are loyal to God. I will declare what he has done for me.

17.w: I cried out to him for help and praised him with my tongue.

18.w: If I had harbored sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.

19.w: However, God heard; he listened to my prayer.

20.w: God deserves praise, for he did not reject my prayer or abandon his love for me.
